title: Concept: Spring Actuator configuration properties dump
description: A Spring Actuator configprops document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: It prints every bound configuration property with its value, which includes connection pools, mail credentials and third-party API endpoints.
applicability: Deployments that render a Spring Actuator configprops document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: It prints every bound configuration property with its value, which includes connection pools, mail credentials and third-party API endpoints.
